video_title: Lakers Practice Interview 2026-27 Season: Coach JJ Redick, Austin Reaves, Walker Kessler

quotes.speaker: JJ Redick
quotes.summary_phrase: JJ Redick on Walker Kessler's status and performance
quotes.excerpt: best I've ever seen him play
quotes.quote: Walker Kessler is the best I've ever seen him play.
quotes.social_post: JJ Redick is high on Walker Kessler early in his tenure saying the big man is the best he has ever seen him play.

structured.context: Coach JJ Redick comments on the current performance level of Walker Kessler.

quotes.speaker: JJ Redick
quotes.summary_phrase: JJ Redick on the challenges of the current road trip
quotes.excerpt: This entire road trip is a massive challenge for us.
quotes.quote: This entire road trip is a massive challenge for us. Four games, all are going to present their different tests. Playing against the Western Conference Finals champion from last year, who are off to a great start, starting with that, and then you get Memphis, Houston, New Orleans. There is a lot on this trip. It is not just one game.
quotes.social_post: JJ Redick calls the Lakers upcoming four game road trip a massive challenge as the team prepares to face the Western Conference champions.

structured.context: JJ Redick discusses the challenges presented by the team's upcoming four-game road trip.

quotes.speaker: JJ Redick
quotes.summary_phrase: JJ Redick on the team's identity as contenders or fakes
quotes.excerpt: Whether we lose the game, whether we win the game, we're either going to be contenders
quotes.quote: Whether we lose the game, whether we win the game, we're either going to be contenders on first take or we're not going to be contenders and we're fake. That stuff is just noise. We're going to focus on the process of trying to get better and it's a good test to see where we're at right now.
quotes.social_post: JJ Redick says he is ignoring the noise about whether the Lakers are contenders or fakes and is focusing on the process of getting better.

structured.context: JJ Redick addresses how media narratives regarding the team's status as contenders are irrelevant to their internal process.

quotes.speaker: JJ Redick
quotes.summary_phrase: JJ Redick on the difficulty of improving multiple areas
quotes.excerpt: you can't try to get better at nine things at the same time
quotes.quote: You can't try to get better at nine things at the same time. Basically, when you focus on, let's say defense, we put an emphasis on defense and get better and all that stuff, your screening may suffer. And like we talked about, that was our emphasis today. Our screening has been dogshit. Part of the reason we haven't been good on offense, we missed shots for sure, but we've also not screened well.
quotes.social_post: JJ Redick did not mince words about the Lakers offensive struggles saying our screening has been dogshit.

structured.context: JJ Redick explains that the team is currently prioritizing improvements in screening to boost offensive efficiency.

quotes.speaker: JJ Redick
quotes.summary_phrase: JJ Redick on signing Ziaire Williams
quotes.excerpt: we got to get this guy in our locker room
quotes.quote: Ziaire Williams was supposed to make six and a half million from Brooklyn this year and then he was a non-guaranteed deal so they wave him and he becomes a free agent. He was willing to go to a gym in Vegas and work out for our coaching staff and for Rob. We put him through that, he looked great. I met with him the next day at the hotel for about 45 minutes and towards the middle of that conversation I just kept thinking to myself, holy shit, we got to get this guy in our locker room. We need this guy to be a Laker.
quotes.social_post: JJ Redick reveals he knew he had to sign Ziaire Williams after a 45 minute meeting saying holy shit we got to get this guy in our locker room.

structured.context: JJ Redick explains the process of scouting and signing free agent Ziaire Williams to the team.

quotes.speaker: Austin Reaves
quotes.summary_phrase: Austin Reaves on returning to play after injury
quotes.excerpt: felt good to play basketball again
quotes.quote: It felt good to play basketball again. The wind was a little bad, but kind of to be expected being out two weeks. Felt good, we'll see how I wake up tomorrow if we're still going in the right direction, but felt really good today.
quotes.social_post: Austin Reaves says he felt good returning to practice after a two week injury layoff and is monitoring how his body reacts tomorrow.

structured.context: Austin Reaves discusses how he felt returning to the court after missing two weeks due to injury.

quotes.speaker: Austin Reaves
quotes.summary_phrase: Austin Reaves on the nature of his foot injury
quotes.excerpt: It was just a heel contusion
quotes.quote: I had no idea. I tried to play through it and then I drove baseline, planted on it and was like, I can't do this. So I walked to the back and was in some pretty bad pain. I didn't think I broke my foot, but it sure felt like I broke my foot. But it was just a heel contusion and there's not much you can really do. You try to stay off of it as much as possible, but there's no certain thing you can do to make the process speed up. You kind of just got to let time take care of everything.
quotes.social_post: Austin Reaves details his recent foot injury saying he initially feared he broke his foot before learning it was a heel contusion.

structured.context: Austin Reaves clarifies the nature of his heel contusion and the recovery process.

quotes.speaker: Walker Kessler
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler on improving his defensive impact
quotes.excerpt: got to be more physical in screens
quotes.quote: I think as a team, me included, got to be more physical in screens, got to make better contact. Me personally, got to have better angles, you know, kind of force that over. Just continue to work on that will be good.
quotes.social_post: Walker Kessler says he needs to be more physical with his screens and improve his defensive angles to help the Lakers team defense.

structured.context: Walker Kessler discusses the need for the team to improve their physical screening and defensive positioning.

quotes.speaker: Walker Kessler
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler on JJ Redick's radical transparency
quotes.excerpt: He does exactly what you need to hear, not what you want to hear
quotes.quote: I love it. I think he does exactly what you need to hear, not what you want to hear all the time and a coach that can do that, is not afraid to do that, I respect. I think the players respect that and it doesn't waste a lot of time. You get a lot more stuff done instead of dancing around subjects, you know, he's very blunt and I think it's a good way to be.
quotes.social_post: Walker Kessler on playing for JJ Redick saying he loves the coaches blunt approach because he tells you what you need to hear not what you want to hear.

structured.context: Walker Kessler shares his appreciation for JJ Redick's direct and transparent coaching style.

quotes.speaker: Walker Kessler
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler on the upcoming matchup against Victor Wembanyama
quotes.excerpt: obviously the matchup with Wembanyama, he's a great player
quotes.quote: Obviously the matchup with Wembanyama, he's a great player, unprecedented the kind of player he is. But like you said, it's going to be a team effort. For me, I'm just going to focus on doing what I do to win the game and hope the team win.
quotes.social_post: Walker Kessler on the upcoming matchup against Victor Wembanyama saying it will be a team effort to contain the unprecedented talent.

structured.context: Walker Kessler discusses the upcoming challenge of playing against Victor Wembanyama.
